```plato

    // Two quadrics summed: the form of the sum is the sum of the forms, which is
    // what makes an edge's quadric the sum of its endpoints'.
    Add(a: Quadric, b: Quadric): Quadric
        => Quadric(a.Coefficients + b.Coefficients);
```
